claims.quote: I think there are like lot of policy-level changes that we implemented after what happened last to last quarter. And we have seen goodness coming in the last quarter as well.
claims.speaker: Ishan Bansal
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 7
claims.weight_note: Margin trading (MTF) is one product line; the call does not give its share of revenue.
claims.what_to_look_for: Reports of MTF/margin problems, forced selling, or customer complaints about margin or withdrawals.

claims.quote: There was an issue that we faced because on a particular expiry day, the files got delayed. Because of that, there was a one-time hit of around INR10 crores to INR13 crore
claims.speaker: Ishan Bansal
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 3
claims.weight_note: Cost impact is small relative to total costs; the claim is that the issue was one-time.
claims.what_to_look_for: Repeated outages, order failures, app crashes or delayed settlements after the expiry day.

claims.quote: if you are giving more value to the customers than what we are charging, I think customers will be happy. They feel fair
claims.speaker: Lalit Keshre
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 6
claims.weight_note: Applies to the whole product range; the app reviews cover only the Groww app.
claims.what_to_look_for: Complaints about charges, hidden fees, brokerage or pricing changes.

claims.quote: The feedback is really good from the customers.
claims.speaker: Lalit Keshre
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 6
claims.weight_note: US stocks is a new, small product; the call says it is very early.
claims.what_to_look_for: Customer comments about the US stocks feature (onboarding, funding, withdrawals, support).

claims.quote: our cost to operate has remained flat quarter-on-quarter
claims.speaker: Lalit Bhimani
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 5
claims.weight_note: Careers-page job count shows hiring intent only, not actual cost.
claims.what_to_look_for: Open-role count and its change over time; sharp hiring freeze or sharp expansion.

claims.quote: we are still highly underpenetrated from a both customer as well as the market share perspective. We expect this to keep on growing for the foreseeable future.
claims.speaker: Ishan Bansal
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 4
claims.weight_note: This is a forward-looking statement; evidence can only show current direction.
claims.what_to_look_for: Customer growth signals, review volume trends, hiring trend, news on market share.

claims.topic: CAS rule impact expected to normalise
claims.quote: Hence, our expectation is that it will go back to like normal in some ways.
claims.speaker: Ishan Bansal
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 4
claims.weight_note: Regulatory statement about the derivatives segment; depends on SEBI's final circular.
claims.what_to_look_for: News on SEBI closing-auction (CAS) rule, its start date or effect on derivatives volumes.

claims.quote: Our expectation is it's not going to be a material change to our cost in any case
claims.speaker: Ishan Bansal
claims.source: Groww Q2 FY27 earnings call, PDF page 14
claims.weight_note: The cost depends on the final regulator decision on UPI charges and any cap.
claims.what_to_look_for: News on UPI charges for capital-market use, caps, or final regulator decisions.
